notice: Guided ADE elicitation contract: what the Primary ADE must do when it conducts the Initial Design Questionnaire. The CLI performs only the handoff (template.materialize, then hands the working copy to the Primary ADE). Content, questions, structure and evolution belong to the questionnaire itself; each directive cites where the questionnaire states it.

directives.text: Inspect the project before asking anything that existing evidence answers.
Ask progressively, never the whole form at once.
directives.questionnaire: 2. Important Rule: Do Not Interrogate the User With the Whole Form

directives.text: Do not ask what the project already establishes.
Keep unknowns visible as [VACÍO]; keep a list of relevant unknowns.
Expose disagreements between sources or answers as [CONFLICTO]; never choose a winner silently.
Mark every option you suggest as [PROPUESTA]; a proposal is never a decision.
Attribute what the project shows with [FUENTE: file:line]; preserve the human's wording for requirements.
Ask for explicit human confirmation whenever an architectural decision is required; never fill 'Human decision' for the human.
Never invent an architectural decision to complete a section.

minimum_viable_design.becomes: source-material: reviewed by the human (Confirmation A), preserved verbatim as SOURCE-BRIEF.md; never governed architecture by being completed
